name: Red-bellied Woodpecker
facts: Red-bellied Woodpeckers are common in mature woods and suburban neighborhoods, often visiting suet feeders.
Their name is a bit misleading: the red on the belly is subtle and often hard to see in the field.
They are strong climbers with a striking, looping, undulating flight pattern between trees.
